title: Lunar Prospector GRS Elemental Abundance, high-altitude 2 degree equal-area table (LPGRS_HIGH1_ELEM_ABUNDANCE_2DEG, LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0)

links.label: PDS Geosciences Node: Lunar Prospector GRS Elemental Abundance

statements.text: T. H. Prettyman, Planetary Science Institute, and the Lunar Prospector spectrometer team; the table holds the abundances reported by Prettyman et al. (2006), Journal of Geophysical Research 111, E12007, doi:10.1029/2005JE002656. Archive assembled by the NASA PDS Geosciences Node.
statements.evidence: PDS3 label PRODUCER_FULL_NAME and DESCRIPTION; dataset.cat CITATION_DESC.

statements.text: Publicly archived NASA mission scientific data; preserve producer and PDS citation.

Measured from about 100 km altitude, where the spectrometer resolved about 5 degrees of arc; the 2 degree pixels oversample it. The data set evaluates only FeO, TiO2, K and Th at 2 degrees and advises caution with the other oxides. U is tied to Th (U = 0.27 Th).
statements.scope: Spatial resolution and which columns are evaluated.
